definitions.core_principle: The 12th is the 'back side' of life: secrets, spirituality, sleep, sorrow/forgetting, expenditure, good and bad, loss, addiction, solitude, hospital/jail, family separation, foreign life, relocation, marital intimacy, fear/psychology, Each can turn positive or negative depending on the 12th lord.
definitions.strong_12th_lord: own sign / exalted, OR in kendra/trikona, OR in 3/6/8 (dusthana lord in dusthana = viparita), OR conjunct/aspected by Jupiter or Venus, OR connected to lord_1/lord_5/lord_9
definitions.weak_12th_lord: retrograde without Rahu/Ketu link, debilitated, in 6/8/12 FROM the 12th, or with malefics
definitions.dasa_gate: Every result acts only in the dasa/bhukti of the 12th lord or a planet placed in/connected to the 12th; a combination whose dasa falls outside the relevant age window is dormant.
definitions.subha_virayam: Expenditure that becomes investment (property, business, deposits, charity) is the good side of the 12th - the source of the 'crorepati yoga'.

rules.name: Crorepati yoga via investment
rules.condition: strong_12th_lord, its dasa running in earning years
rules.result: Spending turns into wealth - house, property, car, new business, charitable trust; returns multiply. Wealth via re-investment rather than salary alone.

rules.name: Retrograde 12th lord dasa
rules.condition: lord_12 retrograde, NOT connected to Rahu/Ketu, any house
rules.result: Debt never seen before; struggles to meet commitments; in old age loses or is cheated of savings - advise guarding retirement money.

rules.name: Retrograde planet in 12th
rules.condition: any retrograde planet in 12th, its dasa running
rules.result: The houses that planet owns get damaged (e.g. retrograde lord_4 in 12: property sold/mortgaged or disputed).

rules.name: 4th lord in 12th

branches.then: Yogic: buys land/house, property growth, good health, earns through travel
Plans to buy but ends up selling; health disturbance in its dasa

rules.related: lord_6 in 4th or lord_4 in 6th running dasa/bhukti -> health disturbance in that period

rules.name: 6th lord in 12th
rules.result: Good health; hospitalisation not indicated (viparita logic).

branches.then: Sound, dreamless sleep - peace of mind regardless of wealth
Gets over grief quickly; lightens the mood of others
Holds on to grief; sleeplessness after losses

rules.name: Moon in 12th - deity dreams
rules.result: Dreams of deities (female deities if Moon/sign feminine, male if masculine); tends to fear that imagined bad things will happen.

rules.name: 3rd-12th lord link
rules.condition: lord_3 and lord_12 together in 3rd or 12th, dasa in youth
rules.result: Heightened desire and spending on appearance/vehicles to impress; dormant if dasa not in youth.

rules.name: Addiction risk
rules.condition: weak_12th_lord AND (Saturn/Rahu/Ketu or a retrograde planet in 12th)
rules.result: Exposure to intoxicants (incl. 'addiction to praise') during that dasa; can derail progress.
rules.exception: lord_12 in 6th or 8th (viparita) -> no attachment; may even profit from trading such goods.

rules.name: Love of solitude
rules.condition: any of: lord_1, lord_5, lord_9 or Moon in 12th

rules.name: Humiliation
rules.condition: lord_5 or lord_9 in 12th AND weak AND weak_12th_lord
rules.result: Humiliation, by type of planet in 12th: Jupiter - money/relations; Venus - through a woman; Mercury - transactions, property litigation; Saturn - workplace; Mars - relatives/police/court.

rules.name: Family separation (2nd lord)
rules.condition: lord_2 retrograde/afflicted in 12th, lord_12 not strong
rules.result: Family discord / spousal separation in that dasa; duration = that dasa/bhukti only (may be just work abroad, not divorce).
rules.exception: Mesha lagna: lord_2 Venus exalted in 12th - no problem unless dispositor Jupiter retrograde (halves Venus).

rules.name: Family separation (7th lord)
rules.exception: Mithuna lagna: lord_7 Jupiter in 12th (Vrishabha) is a strong yoga - wealth, good family, children. (Jupiter own sign in 7th for Mithuna is harmful unless retrograde; if its star lord is debilitated, only marriage delay.)

rules.name: Foreign life
rules.condition: lord_7 connected to 12th/lord_12, OR lord_5 with/in 12th AND strong_12th_lord
rules.result: Long foreign life; PR / citizenship / family migration.

rules.name: Relocation
rules.condition: dasa of: lord_12 in 4th, lord_4 in 12th, lord_7 in 12th, or lord_12 in 7th
rules.result: Unavoidable change of job/business/residence in the dasa; short onsite stints in the bhukti. Good or bad decided by strength of the dispositor.

rules.name: Marital intimacy

branches.if: lord_12 in 3/6/8, own sign in 12th, kendra/trikona, or with/aspected by Jupiter or Venus

rules.note: Speaker: most household quarrels arise from money or the bedroom.

rules.name: Trance / divine possession
rules.condition: Ketu or lord_5/lord_9 connected to 12th AND strong_12th_lord
rules.result: Strong devotional emotion, trance in temple settings.

rules.name: Fear and anxiety
rules.condition: lord_5/lord_9 retrograde (no node link) connected to 12th, or waning Moon with Rahu/Ketu in 12th
rules.result: Fear, anxiety, psychological pressure; (in children) premature birth risk. Psychological issues always involve lord_12 or lord_5.

rules.name: Income till the end
rules.condition: lord_12 own/exalted, in kendra/trikona, or with/aspected by Jupiter
rules.result: Money keeps flowing to the last; no need to hoard for retirement.

rules.name: Investment over business
rules.condition: lord_5 connected to the running dasa lord
rules.result: Earns better from investing (mutual funds, shares/options, FDs, property) than from running a business. Sudden windfalls come from the 12th.

rules.name: 12th lord in 2nd
rules.result: Thrifty; in its dasa most earnings are saved.

rules.name: Debilitated 12th lord with neecha-bhanga
rules.example: Simha lagna: Moon debilitated in Vrischika, dispositor Mars own sign in Mesha -> neecha-bhanga raja yoga; excellent dasa.

rules.name: Spiritual 12th
rules.result: life swings between extremes, pilgrimages, secret charity and quiet spiritual depth.

rules.name: Q&A examples
examples: Kumbha lagna, Saturn in 12th (direct): crorepati potential in Saturn dasa
Rishabha lagna, Sun + Saturn in 12th: both dasas good (trade, prosperity)
Mithuna lagna, Rahu in 12th: raja yoga if Venus strong; Rahu dasa yogic if Venus and Rahu's star lord connect
Simha lagna, Rahu+Mercury+Venus in 12th: Rahu dasa good if Moon (sign lord) and star lord in mutual kendra/trikona, aspect or conjunction
Transit Jupiter over natal Jupiter: wealth, status, health - provided natal Jupiter is not retrograde

excluded_from_engine: Classical verses on sexual deviance and unlawful relationships - not reproduced, not computed
